changes: Added finding_cluster to the default DEV phaseTools list, extended flow-stability smoke coverage, and hardened the process-fact contract with exact DEV phaseTools string-literal parsing.
usage: In any local project using this Koala build, a DEV story can run koala finding_cluster with its storyId before dispatching grouped reviewer finding fixes.
expectedOutcome: In a DEV story like SimCell B-cacf, running koala finding_cluster with the active storyId should not print the DEV-stage unavailable-command error; it should return a normal cluster summary or no-findings result.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/cli.js finding_cluster JSON(storyId=B-8bb5) returned: Clustered 2 findings into 2 clusters: CL-001 and CL-002. node packages/main/dist/cli.js bug_report JSON(...) still returned the DEV-stage unavailable-command error, proving the negative boundary stayed intact.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match: finding_cluster is accepted in DEV, while unrelated bug_report remains blocked in DEV.
pitfalls: Pre-merge worktree verification must use node packages/main/dist/cli.js after build; the global koala symlink still points at main dist until DONE merges the story back.
